analyst_view.overall: Early view: Game 3 at Toyota Stadium on Wednesday 2 December, only played if the series is 1-1, with the kick-off time still to be set; a draw goes to penalties. Portland would face a long trip from Providence Park four days after Game 2, which helps Dallas. These two drew 2-2 and Portland won 2-1 in Frisco in the regular season.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. These are two of the West's more open teams, which pushes the total up, but a decider after a long trip for Portland, in the third meeting in under two weeks, tends to slow things down; the two effects roughly cancel, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The site expects 10.1 corners. Without news on wide players or set pieces I stay with the number, though Dallas pressing at home for the series could push it slightly up.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards and lean under 4.5. I lean higher for a third game in under two weeks with a conference semifinal at stake; tired legs late on and frustration carried over from the first two games tend to bring more fouls.

shots.text: The site expects 25.4 shots. I leaned higher for Game 1 because of Portland's attacking form, but their travel and short rest before a decider in Texas should take some energy out of their game, so I stay with the number here.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 on target. Musa for Dallas and Lassiter and Velde for Portland keep the quality high, but a cautious decider should not push it higher, so I stay with the number.
